title: Wildstrubel by UTMB — official Wild 110 GPX (WILD110K_officiel)
publisher: Wildstrubel by UTMB / UTMB World Series
claims: The Wild 110 race page exposes a direct official GPX download at pdf.utmb.world under the Wild 100M/GPX path; a HEAD request on 2026-11-20 returned HTTP 200 with 1,054,122 bytes.
The GPX metadata names the track WILD110K_officiel and the creator field credits MySchweizMobil (https://map.schweizmobil.ch/).
The file contains 11,677 track points; a local planar calculation gives 111.93 km, with a 3 m elevation threshold giving +6,433 m and −6,430 m between 1,064.5 m and 2,790 m.
The GPX has no licence or copyright grant; the official page provides the file for navigation but does not permit redistribution, so this site only links to it.

verification.checkedVia: official race page HTML + direct GPX download
verification.note: Direct URL extracted from the Wild 110 page; file downloaded to a temporary directory, measured locally, then deleted. No track is hosted or mirrored.
